MXTCMDSHELL.description: MXT Command Shell (MXTCMDSHELL). Imports raw MXT command-shell text into the currently open project; the request body carries the MXT command data as a single string that is parsed and applied to the model.

Argument.description: MXT command-shell data as a single text string. The value is passed verbatim to the MXT import routine (OnImportMxt); a project must already be open. Wrong or unparseable input fails the request.
